name: react-photo-details-lightbox-workspace
description: A photography-first metadata inspector for Yet Another React Lightbox.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace react-photo-details-lightbox && npm run build --workspace @photo-details/docs
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build:package && npm run build:cloudflare --workspace @photo-details/docs
scripts.build:sites: npm run build:package && npm run build:sites --workspace @photo-details/docs && node scripts/package-sites.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:package && npm run test:e2e --workspace @photo-details/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:package && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:package
